asr.asr_text: After the pandemic, many offices changed how people sit at work. Instead of giving each person a desk, they introduced hot desking. A worker comes in, finds an empty desk, and uses it for the day. No personal desk is waiting. Now, some offices are changing again. Reports show some companies bringing back assigned desks for certain workers or teams. In this system, a person or team has a regular place.
